2608.08392.title: CAP: A Scalable Benchmark for Evaluating Cross-Site Browser Agents with Complex Actions and Perception
2608.08392.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that interact with the web through browsers. While recent progress has been driven by benchmarks that evaluate end-to-end task success, these evaluations largely overlook two fundamental sources of difficulty in real web browsing: complex actions over rich user interfaces and visual perception of dynamically rendered content, especially in workflows that span multiple websites. We introduce CAP, a scalable benchmark for evaluating browser agents on cross-site, human-like web tasks that require non-trivial UI interactions and visual understanding. Specifically, we adopt a decomposition-and-recomposition pipeline that first abstracts each website into a structured site card capturing user-facing functions, complex execution operations, and perceptual requirements, and then recomposes these components into realistic cross-site workflows. Each task is therefore grounded in multiple specific operations on each website, enabling fine-grained diagnosis. Built on this framework, we construct 420 tasks across 108 real-world websites and 24 domains under careful quality control. Experiments on state-of-the-art browser agents using our verifiable agent-as-a-judge evaluation framework show low success rates and reveal that perception-heavy interactions remain a major bottleneck, exposing substantial gaps between current agents and real-world web browsing demands.
2608.08392.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地被部署為自主代理，通過瀏覽器與網絡互動。雖然最近的進展是由評估端到端任務成功的基準推動的，但這些評估在很大程度上忽視了真實網頁瀏覽中的兩個基本困難來源：在豐富用戶界面上的複雜操作和對動態呈現內容的視覺感知，特別是在跨多個網站的工作流程中。我們介紹了CAP，一個可擴展的基準，用於評估在跨站點、人類般的網絡任務中需要非平凡的UI交互和視覺理解的瀏覽器代理。具體而言，我們採用一個分解和重組的流程，首先將每個網站抽象為一個結構化的網站卡，捕捉用戶面對的功能、複雜的執行操作和感知要求，然後將這些組件重組為現實的跨站點工作流程。因此，每個任務都基於每個網站上的多個具體操作，使得細緻的診斷成為可能。在這一框架的基礎上，我們在108個現實網站和24個領域中構建了420個任務，並在仔細的質量控制下進行。使用我們的可驗證代理作為評判的評估框架對最先進的瀏覽器代理進行的實驗顯示出低成功率，並揭示了以感知為重的交互仍然是主要瓶頸，暴露了當前代理與現實網頁瀏覽需求之間的重大差距。
